withheld.reason: The verb tremet and the nominative calamus support a trembling pen. The word divided at the line ending is iterum. The sequence before it appears to read intinctus, a masculine participle that can describe a dipped pen. The earlier reading intuitus gave “my sight” more certainty than the type warrants. The brackets in the English mark the unresolved modifier. A Latin reader should adjudicate the letterforms, the syntax and the placement of iterum.
